findings.detail: The fix correctly makes the internal state truthful, and the `return` before line 336 is load-bearing (without it control would fall through and re-introduce the bug). Worth noting for follow-up: within `SmartLookupTab` the `status` value is only read at lines 506, 509 and 515, all of which test for `PROCESSING`. `ERROR` and `COMPLETED` render identically here, so the only user-visible difference between a failed and a successful download is the `addLog` line at 329. That is consistent with the preceding commit's intent ("say why the spinner stopped"), so this is an observation, not a request. It would rise to `low`/`medium` only if a future change makes the download button's enabled state or the results panel depend on `status`, at which point the ERROR branch would need a visible affordance (e.g. a retry hint next to the download button) rather than a log entry alone.
findings.summary: New ERROR status on the download path has no rendered representation in this tab
